note: A FISSION_CANDIDATE is a sample whose chemistry the natural reservoir family cannot build without a fission-product component, surviving leave-one-out, peak coherence and the named kills; it becomes a boundary-level claim only as a STRATIGRAPHIC_CLUSTER (>= 2 independent sections at one boundary beyond the population rate).  NO_FISSION_VECTOR is a count, not an occurrence limit, and is not written up (CLAUDE.md).  Every survivor is PENDING provenance (core vs outcrop, laboratory, reference) and re-analysis of the sample.
